private:33: Unlimited money and no history. Apparently, anonymity is your first luxury.

You want the outrageous life without anybody recognizing the person living it.
You want to know whether people like you or just the story attached to you.
Your current résumé has become an optional document.

private:34: Finding out you were right would hurt. You'd still rather have the proof.

private:35: You don't need credit. You need someone you love to have a future.
